tenderSchedule.title: Request for Proposal (RFP) for Empanelment of Consulting Agencies for providing IT Non-Consulting Services for a period of Two (2) Years
tenderSchedule.description: Request for Proposal (RFP) for Empanelment of Consulting Agencies for providing IT Non-Consulting Services for a period of Two (2) Years
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka State Electronics Development Corporation Limited

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Karnataka State Electronics Development Corporation Limited First Floor, No 59, Kumara Park West Extension, Railway Parallel Road, Seshadripuram, Bangalore 560020.

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per the tender document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should be a Firm or Company registered in India. Joint Ventures and Consortiums are not allowed
Applicant should have been in existence for a period of at least three (3) years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- GST Registration / Certificate of Incorporation / LLP Registration / Partnership Registration

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicants should be registered with the Commercial Tax Department for GST. Should have filed the latest GST Returns.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- GST Returns for the financial year FY 2025-26.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should be registered with Income Tax Department and should have filed the Income Tax Returns for the preceding three (3) financial years, i.e., FY 2023-24 (AY 2024-25) FY 2024-25 (AY 2025-26) FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Income Tax Returns for the preceding three financial years

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should have an average annual turnover not less than Rs. 30 crores during the preceding three (3) financial years, i.e., FY 2023-24 (AY 2024-25) FY 2024-25 (AY 2025-26) FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annual Turnover and Networth statement for the preceding three (3) financial years certified by Chartered Accountant with UDIN number.
Others -- Audited Balance Sheet and Audited Profit & Loss Statement for the preceding three (3) financial years certified by Chartered Accountant.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should have positive net worth during any one of the preceding three (3) financial years, i.e., FY 2023-24 (AY 2024-25) FY 2024-25 (AY 2025-26) FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annual Turnover and Networth statement for the preceding three (3) financial years certified by Chartered Accountant with UDIN number.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicants should have provided at least three (3) IT Services projects with each project of value not less than Rs. 1 Crore for Central Government / State Government / Public Sector Undertaking during the preceding three (3) financial years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- End User Certificate / Work Completion certificate / Satisfactory Performance Certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should have office in Bengaluru, Karnataka If the Applicant does not have an office in Bengaluru, the Applicant should submit an undertaking stating that they shall open an office in Bengaluru within 30 days of receipt of Letter of Indent / Notification of Award.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- GST Registration / Telephone Bill / Electricity Bill / Lease Agreement in the name of Applicant
Others -- Undertaking to open an office in Bengaluru.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should be ISO 9001 certified in the area of IT services or related services.

Applicant should submit an Affidavit on Rs. 100 stamp paper, notarized, declaring the authenticity of documents, non-blacklisting confirmation, no pending legal disputes, not filed for bankruptcy, restrictions on public procurement from bidders of certain countries, compliance with RFP terms, and consequences of violation.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Affidavit as per format enclosed in RFP. Should be on Rs. 100 stamp paper and notarized.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Applicant should submit a self-declaration Litigation Declaration Form on their letterhead with notarized.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Litigation Declaration Form as per format enclosed in RFP.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Expertise in the Subject Area Applicants experience in IT services provided to Central Government / State Government / Public Sector Undertaking during the preceding three (3) financial years (Should submit work order or purchase order or contract agreement) Each eligible project - 5 marks Maximum - 20 marks

Total number of professionals employed with the Applicant (should be BE / BTech / MSc / MCA / BCA / equivalent) less than 50 professionals - 0 marks greater than equal to 50 and less than 100 professionals - 5 marks greater than equal to 100 and less than 150 professionals - 10 marks greater than equal to 150 and less than 200 professionals - 15 marks greater than 200 professionals - 20 marks
Role wise key professionals employed with the Applicant (should be BE / BTech / MSc / MCA / BCA / equivalent) - As per RFP for Marks criteria

ISO and CMMi Certifications ISO 9001 certification in the area of Information Technology Services or related services 5 marks CMMi certification in the area of Information Technology Services or related services 15 marks CMMi Level 3 5 marks CMMi Level 4 10 marks CMMi Level 5 15 marks
